limitations: No claim of moment convergence or rate of convergence to the ultimate limit law.
Only compact centered time windows for fixed c and uniform coupon weights.
Potential implicit coverage by general earlier perturbation/coupling theory has not been eliminated.
scientific_integrity.proof_dependency: Clumsy critical first-completion law is the cited Theorem 4.10 of Attrill–Garoni; the new work proves a quantified coupling to the careless model.
scientific_integrity.scope: Uniform independent coupon offers, fixed c>0, original post-erasure careless dynamics at per-label \(p=c/n^2\) and single-label clumsy dynamics at \(\varepsilon=c/n\).
scientific_integrity.verification: Finite-state exact-rational checks accompany a self-contained analytic coupling proof; not independent certification.

title: Critical-window coupling of careless and clumsy coupon collectors
